_meta.purpose: Fragile DOM selectors that drive the gscope/swift SPA from inside extension content scripts. Registered here so selector drift surfaces in one place instead of as silent runtime failures.
_meta.policy: When a selector changes, update this file FIRST, then the consumer. Each entry should carry primary + fallback + last_verified.

dispatcher_global_search.purpose: The Global Search affordance on the Dispatcher Trip Dashboard.

icon_trigger.drift_risk: MEDIUM — title attribute is locale-dependent and may change with i18n.

search_input._strategy: First try the 'only visible input' heuristic; if multiple, fall back to TextField-module class-substring match.
search_input.primary: input[type="text"] (filtered by offsetParent !== null, must be the only one visible)
search_input.drift_risk: HIGH — TextField-module is a Material UI build-hash class. Walmart frontend rebuilds may invalidate the substring.

search_submit.fallback: Enter keypress on the search input

in_orders_disambiguation._purpose: After a Global Search matches both phone numbers and order numbers, Walmart shows a disambiguation modal with 'In phone | In orders'. We always want In orders.

orderno_input.drift_risk: LOW — name attribute is one of the few stable identifiers in the gscope SPA.

spa_environment._purpose: Environmental selectors / known third-party extension footprints that affect SparkFraud automation. Not DOM selectors but stable identifiers we need to recognise.

postman_interceptor_extension_id.purpose: When this extension is installed, it intercepts fetch from injected scripts and fails them if Postman desktop isn't running. Detected via 'ajaxRequestInterceptor.ps.js' in stack traces.
postman_interceptor_extension_id.mitigation: Launch Edge with --disable-extensions for automation; for production extension use Playwright context.request or in-tab fetch via executeScript.

edge_extensions_page.behavior: Privileged page — Playwright evaluate() and shadow-DOM walks return nothing. Do NOT try to drive it.
edge_extensions_page.mitigation: Build chrome.runtime.reload() into the extension UI (#dev-reload in app.html). Playwright clicks #dev-reload to reload the whole extension.

react_controlled_input_pattern._purpose: Not a selector but a write-pattern. Setting input.value directly does not fire React's onChange. Documented here so it's not re-discovered.
react_controlled_input_pattern.applies_to: All in-tab executeScript-driven form fills. Playwright fill() handles this automatically.
